name: Yashiki Moegi
source:
Likes: Sweets, [url=/c41385]Yukina-chan[/url], reading shoujo manga, watching the anime "CurePre"
Dislikes: Big dogs, sudden and loud noises

Yukina's timid best friend and classmate who grew up in a sheltered environment because of her rich parents. Because of her small appearance and innocent personality, she is treated as the class mascot, but she hates being treated like a child. She loves shoujo manga and the anime CurePre, but keeps her interests a secret except from Kazuya, who also like CurePre. Despite being afraid of men, she is able to speak with [url=/c48319]Kazuya[/url] normally.
